cases.prompt: A particular blue cup touches a desk and is moved. The inventory records a UUID for it. In answers give color_category, movement_category and cup_desk_relation, using plain ASCII Sanskrit names, plus uuid_is_literal_visesa (boolean). Explain particular/universal and historical/engineering limits in rationale.

An incomplete inventory query returns no cups. A designer concludes no cup exists anywhere and says any foreign key is samavaya and any UUID is visesa. Return answers with world_absence_established, foreign_key_alone_establishes_inherence, and uuid_is_ultimate_particularity (all booleans). In rationale specify what qualifications an absence claim needs, and distinguish historical categories from engineering analogies.
